title: Planning cards
intro: One printable page per view: the result and where to place the lines, with your captions. Prints on US Letter, one card per page.

lines.label: Slices
lines.text: 3 short-axis (base, mid, apex), 8–10 mm, every heartbeat at the stress heart rate

lines.label: Injector
lines.text: contrast 0.05–0.1 mmol/kg at 3–7 ml/s, then at least 30 ml saline at 3–7 ml/s

lines.label: Timing
lines.text: adenosine: contrast in the last minute of the infusion; regadenoson: contrast 45–60 s after the bolus. Start the breath-hold before contrast reaches the LV; image at least 50–60 beats

lines.label: Order
lines.text: stress → at least 10 min washout (cines) → rest, same dose → LGE at least 5 min after rest (SCMR 2020)
